surfaceMatrix.summary: Strings, keys, numbers, booleans, nulls, arrays, and nested objects are checked before output redaction.
Quality requires the reviewed minimum case count and exact rational pass and regression thresholds.
Request, aggregate, and observed costs retain exact catalog decimal precision through the hard gate.
Repeated candidate observations derive quality, latency, and cost variance instead of placeholder zeros.
Concurrent terminal failures reduce through fixed precedence and incomplete runs remain non-actionable.

residualRisks: Live OpenRouter behavior remains outside offline CI and needs an explicit field-operation grant.
V1-07 must compose recommendation authorization with exact receipt and current-policy verification.
